title: How to Make a Quarto Blog
section: Steps to Create a Quarto Blog
text:
Steps to Create a Quarto Blog

Install Quarto: https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/
Create a new project folder.
Add a _quarto.yml configuration file.
Create posts in the posts/ directory, each in its own folder with an index.qmd file.
Customize your blog with themes and CSS.
Render your site with quarto render.

Happy blogging!
